findings.text: blocking: done_when is read from pointer["node"], but runs.list_live() returns the slim listing record whose done_when lives in the node_body file; measured 0 of 171 live pointers carry it inline while runs.node_field resolves it for all 171, so a source-only run is measured only by the importer fallback and the done-when source the node exists to add never fires. The same direct read is at reckon/crew/delivery_scope.py:99 and reckon/crew/promotion_records.py:994 and :1019.

non-blocking: the fixture puts done_when inline on node, the shape only a pre-move pointer has, so the four cases pass while the production slim pointer makes the same path return empty; that shape mismatch is what hid the blocking defect above.

non-blocking: _NAMED_TEST_PATH is a second rule for "a test path a text names", whose owner _TEST_PATH_PATTERN lives at reckon/crew/recovery_repair_dispatch.py:814 and is already reached by reckon/crew/node.py:1206; the new rule also admits any .py token rather than only tests/ paths.

item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when names tests/test_a_landing_measures_the_tests_its_done_when_names.py and the manifest records the scoped gate at 62 passed, the after arm at 62 passed against the base arm at base 31eda5cd at 58 passed, and a negative control at EXIT=1 with four failures; the gate asserts the measure's own recorded arm files, but every case builds its pointer at tests/test_a_landing_measures_the_tests_its_done_when_names.py:91 with node.done_when inline, the pre-move shape production no longer writes.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is that a landing measures the tests a run's done-when names when the run writes no test file; reckon/crew/landing_measure.py:637 resolves four sources, but every done-when read goes through `pointer["node"]["done_when"]` at reckon/crew/queue_landing.py:1328, which is empty on all 171 pointers runs.list_live() returns, so the done-when source never fires in the landing pass.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, commits d074025635a141f9ee24bd7af8c5c505c60f1dc5, zero added failures, negative_control_log at EXIT=1 with four failed, and no retry failures; the three gate logs' summary lines match its 62/58/62 and EXIT=1 claims.
